3	-- Idempotent — safe to run on environments that already have seeds.

6	-- ============================================================

9	do $$

20	-- ── Seed function ────────────────────────────────────────────
21	create or replace function seed_default_role_permissions()
22	returns void
23	language plpgsql
24	as $$
25	declare
26	  -- Full permission registry (keep in sync with lib/team/permission-labels.ts)
27	  all_perms text[] := array[
28	    -- bookings (9)
29	    'bookings.read_all','bookings.read_own','bookings.create','bookings.update_any',
30	    'bookings.update_own','bookings.cancel_any','bookings.cancel_own','bookings.delete','bookings.no_show',
31	    -- clients (7)

33	    -- artists (6)
34	    'artists.read','artists.read_own','artists.create','artists.update_any','artists.update_own','artists.delete',
35	    -- calendar (4)
36	    'calendar.read_all','calendar.read_own','calendar.manage_any','calendar.manage_own',
37	    -- consent (4)
38	    'consent.view_all','consent.view_own','consent.send_request','consent.delete',
39	    -- inventory (2)
40	    'inventory.read','inventory.manage',
41	    -- commissions (4)
42	    'commissions.view','commissions.view_own','commissions.manage','commissions.approve',
43	    -- payroll (2)
44	    'payroll.view','payroll.manage',
45	    -- ai (1)
46	    'ai.use',
47	    -- settings (7)
48	    'settings.studio','settings.team','settings.billing','settings.booking_page',
49	    'settings.branding','settings.integrations','settings.services',
50	    -- billing (2)
51	    'billing.view','billing.cancel_studio',
52	    -- admin (4)
53	    'admin.change_roles','admin.deactivate','admin.invite','admin.view_audit'
54	  ];
55	
56	  owner_perms        text[] := all_perms;
57	  admin_perms        text[];
58	  artist_perms       text[];
59	  receptionist_perms text[];
60	  guest_perms        text[];
61	  perm text;
62	begin
63	  -- ADMIN: everything except billing.cancel_studio + settings.billing
64	  admin_perms := array(
65	    select unnest(all_perms) except select unnest(array['billing.cancel_studio','settings.billing'])
66	  );
67	
68	  -- ARTIST: own bookings/clients/calendar, ai, view own commissions
69	  artist_perms := array[
70	    'bookings.read_own','bookings.create','bookings.update_own','bookings.cancel_own','bookings.no_show',
71	    'clients.read_own','clients.create','clients.update',
72	    'artists.read_own','artists.update_own',
73	    'calendar.read_own','calendar.manage_own',
74	    'consent.view_own','consent.send_request',
75	    'inventory.read',
76	    'commissions.view_own',
77	    'ai.use'
78	  ];
79	
80	  -- RECEPTIONIST: front-desk booking/client management, no money
81	  receptionist_perms := array[
82	    'bookings.read_all','bookings.create','bookings.update_any','bookings.cancel_any','bookings.no_show',
83	    'clients.read','clients.create','clients.update',
84	    'artists.read',
85	    'calendar.read_all','calendar.manage_any',
86	    'consent.view_all','consent.send_request',
87	    'inventory.read',
88	    'ai.use',
89	    'admin.invite'
90	  ];
91	
92	  -- GUEST_ARTIST: own data only, minimal surface (see sidebar: Today, Inbox, Calendar, Messages)
93	  guest_perms := array[
94	    'bookings.read_own',
95	    'clients.read_own',
96	    'artists.read_own',
97	    'calendar.read_own',
98	    'consent.view_own',
99	    'commissions.view_own',
100	    'ai.use'
101	  ];
102	
103	  -- Upsert granted=true for every role × its granted perms
104	  foreach perm in array owner_perms loop
105	    insert into role_permissions (role, permission_key, granted)
106	    values ('owner', perm, true)
107	    on conflict (role, permission_key) do nothing;
108	  end loop;
109	
110	  foreach perm in array admin_perms loop
111	    insert into role_permissions (role, permission_key, granted)
112	    values ('admin', perm, true)
113	    on conflict (role, permission_key) do nothing;
114	  end loop;
115	
116	  foreach perm in array artist_perms loop
117	    insert into role_permissions (role, permission_key, granted)
118	    values ('artist', perm, true)
119	    on conflict (role, permission_key) do nothing;
120	  end loop;
121	
122	  foreach perm in array receptionist_perms loop
123	    insert into role_permissions (role, permission_key, granted)
124	    values ('receptionist', perm, true)
125	    on conflict (role, permission_key) do nothing;
126	  end loop;
127	
128	  foreach perm in array guest_perms loop
129	    insert into role_permissions (role, permission_key, granted)
130	    values ('guest_artist', perm, true)
131	    on conflict (role, permission_key) do nothing;
132	  end loop;
133	
134	  -- Denied rows: every preset role × every perm NOT in its granted list
135	  -- gets granted=false for explicit "this role does NOT have X" rows.
136	  -- These make the matrix UI render cleanly without ambiguity.
137	  foreach perm in array all_perms loop
138	    if not (perm = any(admin_perms)) then
139	      insert into role_permissions (role, permission_key, granted)
140	      values ('admin', perm, false)
141	      on conflict (role, permission_key) do nothing;
142	    end if;
143	    if not (perm = any(artist_perms)) then
144	      insert into role_permissions (role, permission_key, granted)
145	      values ('artist', perm, false)
146	      on conflict (role, permission_key) do nothing;
147	    end if;
148	    if not (perm = any(receptionist_perms)) then
149	      insert into role_permissions (role, permission_key, granted)
150	      values ('receptionist', perm, false)
151	      on conflict (role, permission_key) do nothing;
152	    end if;
153	    if not (perm = any(guest_perms)) then
154	      insert into role_permissions (role, permission_key, granted)
155	      values ('guest_artist', perm, false)
156	      on conflict (role, permission_key) do nothing;
157	    end if;
158	  end loop;
159	end;
160	$$;
161	
162	-- ── Run once now ─────────────────────────────────────────────
163	select seed_default_role_permissions();

## InkOS Supabase Database Layer Report

### 1. Tables by Feature Area (86 total tables)

**Booking & Calendar** (7 tables)
- `bookings` — core session reservations (FK: studio, client, artist, project/session)
- `booking_participants` — multi-party attendance tracking
- `booking_photos` — session progress/work photos
- `booking_page_settings` — public booking widget config per studio
- `artist_schedules` — recurring availability patterns
- `artist_blocked_dates` — blackout days
- `schedule_templates` — template-based schedule setup

**Clients & Communications** (8 tables)
- `clients` — contact records (FK: studio)
- `client_notes` — clinical/service notes per client
- `client_tags` — custom categorization
- `client_files` — uploads/documents
- `client_communications` — message thread aggregation (FK: studio, client, conversation, assigned_to)
- `client_views` — saved filtered views
- `client_consent_preferences` — form/communication opt-ins
- `conversations` — message threads (FK: studio, client)

**Artists & Staff** (10 tables)
- `artists` — artist profiles (FK: studio)
- `artist_goals` — performance targets
- `artist_portfolio_items` — portfolio showcase
- `artist_tax_info` — 1099 data (encrypted)
- `artist_time_off` — vacation/leave periods
- `studio_members` — team roster (FK: studio, user)
- `guest_artist_engagements` — residency tracking
- `service_artists` — artist service qualifications
- `studio_custom_roles` — custom permission roles (FK: studio)
- `style_tags` — tattoo style taxonomy (FK: studio)

**Projects & Sessions** (6 tables)
- `projects` — multi-session bookings (FK: studio, client, artist; has session_number)
- `project_references` — previous work references
- `project_progress_photos` — session work photos (FK: project, booking)
- `project_deposit_transactions` — installment tracking (FK: project)
- `project_activity_log` — status/note history (FK: project)
- `inbox_assignments` — project task tracking

**Payments & Financial** (7 tables)
- `payments` — deposits/final payments (FK: studio, booking, client; integrates Dodo payment)
- `invoices` — customer billing records
- `commission_records` — artist earnings (FK: booking, artist)
- `commission_rules` — commission structure by service/client
- `commission_adjustments` — manual commission tweaks
- `commission_disputes` — payout disagreements
- `refund_requests` — refund tracking

**Messaging** (3 tables)
- `message_templates` — templated replies
- `auto_reply_rules` — conditional auto-responses (FK: studio; triage_trigger)
- `missed_calls` — call log (FK: studio)

**Consent & Intake** (6 tables)
- `consent_form_templates` — form design (FK: studio)
- `consent_form_submissions` — filled forms (FK: booking)
- `consent_form_requests` — pending requests (FK: client, booking, template)
- `consent_auto_send_rules` — auto-trigger rules (FK: studio)
- `consent_template_note_mappings` — template → intake note links
- `consent_kiosk_sessions` — kiosk check-in state

**Inventory & Supplies** (4 tables)
- `inventory_items` — stock tracking (FK: studio)
- `inventory_movements` — stock transactions (FK: item, studio)
- `stock_alerts` — low-stock notifications
- `suppliers` — vendor records (FK: studio)

**Flash Events** (3 tables)
- `flash_events` — limited-slot events (FK: studio)
- `flash_event_slots` — individual slots (FK: flash_event, artist, service)
- `flash_event_designs` — designs for slots

**AI & Marketing** (6 tables)
- `ai_design_requests` — user design prompts (FK: studio, artist)
- `ai_design_outputs` — generated designs
- `ai_design_templates` — prompt templates
- `ai_usage_log` — usage tracking (FK: studio, user)
- `marketing_campaigns` — promo campaigns (FK: studio)
- `referral_codes` — referral links (FK: studio)

**Payroll** (3 tables)
- `payroll_runs` — periodic payroll (FK: studio)
- `payroll_payment_batches` — batch payouts
- `payroll_artist_summary` — calculated earnings view

**Other Core** (10 tables)
